clips.title: The story
paras: Power Overwhelming is a quest issued by High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City to assist the secluded Kirin Tor. Players are dispatched to the ruined city of Dalaran to quell a dangerous outbreak of wayward arcane energy manifested as a Mana Elemental.

Following the devastating destruction of Dalaran at the hands of the arch-demon Archimonde during the Third War, the Kirin Tor retreated inward. Once welcoming scholars and sorcerers from across the world, the surviving magi have grown secretive, reclusive, and deeply distrustful of outsiders as they work tirelessly behind closed borders to rebuild their ruined city.

Recent reconstruction efforts to restore Dalaran to its former glory have met severe complications. Dangerous leaks of volatile arcane energies have surged out of control, coalescing into beings of pure mana. Fearing that Dalaran might fall to internal turmoil or abandon its historic ties to the Alliance, High Sorcerer Andromath dispatched champions from Stormwind to quell the Mana Elemental and remind the Kirin Tor of their enduring allies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.
We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A creature of pure mana? Whatever is causing this disturbance is more powerful than initial reports suggested.
Your aid bought them precious time and reminded the Kirin Tor who their allies are. Good work, friend.
